description: Free. Post or edit the human's public review of Car Image (one per account, 1-5 stars, their own words; never invent or nudge a rating). Shown on the reviews page with the team's answer once it passes a quick check. Set marketing_consent only when they agree to be quoted. Editing replaces the displayed public review; confirm the replacement text with the human. One edit an hour; the first post gets a thank-you email.

body.description: The review, in the human's words.

display_company.description: A company to show, only if they want one.

display_name.description: The name to show. Defaults to their first name.

marketing_consent.description: true only if the human agreed that Car Image may quote it in marketing. Default false.

rating.description: 1 to 5 stars, the human's own rating.

title.description: A headline, in the human's words.

use_case.description: What they use the API for.
